initial_grid: analysis_spec.json was written before the corresponding new experiment outputs
additional_power_experiment: Added an independent A/A calibration and held-out A/B evaluation after observing the descriptive sparse-grid errors; a separate seed and simulated samples are used
numerical_refinement: After pilot integration showed excessive computational variance for some patients, added exact integration for support products <=4096 and patient-specific draw budgets; every final estimate uses draws independent of the budget-setting pilot
precision_goal: Aim for score MC SE of order 1e-4; report every measured SE rather than declaring a hard tolerance certificate
phenotype_models: Fixed C=1 logistic models; no endpoint, gene graph or penalty tuning against MMR performance; basic clinical covariates were specified before phenotype-model execution
auc_evaluation: Pooled LOO AUC showed a training-class-prior artifact. LOO log loss and Brier score were retained. Interpretation uses leave-pair-out AUC from a common model for each held-out opposite-status pair
bootstrap_scope: Patient bootstrap for fixed CV predictions; within-patient cell bootstrap for individual score intervals; Monte Carlo batches for integration precision
